utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Hi James, welcome in. How are you doing today?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: I don't know, I just feel so empty inside. Like nothing matters anymore. I go through the motions but there's no spark.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That emptiness you describe — when did it start?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: A few months ago. I used to love painting but now I can't even pick up a brush. What's the point of any of it really.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Let's explore what painting used to mean to you.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: It used to be my escape. Now I just stare at blank canvases and feel numb. Sometimes I wonder if anyone would notice if I just disappeared.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: You've been carrying this alone for a while. Tell me more about what a typical day looks like for you now.
